data.one_liner: Flutter desktop window resizing, moving, showing, hiding via nativeapi.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to control window size, position, visibility and decoration on Windows, macOS and Linux. It exposes native window objects and events through the nativeapi core.
use_when: You need frameless or custom title bars
You want to programmatically resize or reposition windows
You need multi‑window support in a desktop Flutter app
avoid_when: You target only mobile or web
You need a very lightweight dependency and can live without nativeapi
strengths: No platform‑specific plugin code, all logic in nativeapi
Supports custom title bars and multi‑window APIs
weaknesses: Linux needs GTK3, X11 and Xi dev files
Legacy API is deprecated and will be removed
data.setup_notes: Add window_manager to pubspec, run flutter pub get. On Linux install libgtk-3-dev libx11-dev libxi-dev. No build_runner needed.

alternatives.name: win32
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides low‑level Windows window APIs if you only target Windows and need finer control.
